name: VSF Projects Limited
about: VSF Projects Limited engages in the development and execution of construction and infrastructure projects in India. The company offers engineering and construction services for various projects, including thermal, solar, irrigation, water supply, bridges, roads, and industrial. It is also involved in the aquaculture activities. The company was formerly known as Vijaya Shrimp Farms and Exports Limited. VSF Projects Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
